_why: O-COVERAGE-MANIFEST-LOOP-CASES, option (2). Read by tooling/ci/assert-no-loop-cases.mjs, and by nothing else.
Each row is a suite in tooling/ci/test that declares test cases INSIDE a loop (a `for` statement, or a `.forEach(`
/ `.map(` call, whose body calls `test(` / `it(` / `describe(`), and how many such loops it has. coverage-manifest.json
counts a loop-generated case ONCE however many rows the loop iterates, so these are the suites where deleting a table
row deletes a case the ratchet cannot see.
THIS LIST MAY ONLY SHRINK. A suite not listed may declare no case inside a loop (L1); a listed suite may not gain one
(L1); a suite that loses one must lower its row in the same change (L2); a row for a suite that is gone fails (L3).
The manifest floor itself is unchanged, deliberately: see the register row for why an EXECUTED floor was not chosen.
⏱ MEASURED 2026-09-15 on origin/main 5985b0e3 by the guard itself: 40 suites, 68 loop-wrapped declaration sites.
The 2026-09-14 junit measurement also found 40 suites running more cases than they declare (323 cases); that count is
of executed cases, this one of loop heads in source, and the two are different measurements of the same shape.
